# Gym Flooring UK - Sprung Gym Flooring

> > UK's leading gym flooring supplier specializing in rubber tiles, interlocking systems, and shock-absorbing solutions for home and commercial fitness spaces.

Founded by Richard McKay, Sprung Gym Flooring offers comprehensive flooring solutions including their flagship Sprung PRO tiles, Konnecta interlocking systems, and EVA foam options. Based in Glasgow with showrooms in the UK and Dublin, they serve both residential home gym builders and commercial fitness centers with high-traffic, heavy-duty flooring products.

## Key Topics

- Sprung PRO Tiles - Flagship 20mm shock-absorbing rubber flooring
- Konnecta Interlocking Tiles - Easy DIY installation system
- Rubber Flooring - Primary material for gym surfaces
- Shock Absorption - Key performance feature for weight training
- Home Gym Setup - Residential fitness space solutions
- Commercial Gym Flooring - High-traffic fitness center options
- DIY Installation - Self-installation guides and methods
- Heavy-Duty Flooring - CrossFit and Olympic weightlifting rated
- Noise Reduction - Sound dampening properties
- EVA Foam Tiles - Lightweight puzzle tile alternatives
- Underfloor Heating Compatibility - Thermal conductivity considerations
- Richard McKay - Founder and company leader
- UK Supplier - Primary market and distribution
- Product Specifications - Technical data and certifications
